security_audit.summary: The confirmed risk is limited to documented npx claude-flow@alpha command execution in SKILL.md and PROCESS.md. Most scanner hits are false positives from Markdown fences, JavaScript template literals, or a benign Object.keys call, and no prompt injection evidence was found.

remediation.issue: The skill includes runnable npx claude-flow@alpha commands in its workflow examples.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running these commands, pin the package version, and document the expected local side effects.

remediation.issue: Several examples mix placeholders with shell commands that may be copied directly.
remediation.suggestion: Mark command snippets as manual examples or convert them to descriptive steps unless command execution is required.

content.user_title: Plan Token Budgets for Large AI Tasks
content.value_statement: Large AI tasks can overrun token budgets and lose context. This skill estimates usage, splits work into chunks, and creates checkpointed execution plans.
actual_capabilities: Assess current token usage against a configured limit and safety buffer.
Estimate task complexity with base token costs and multipliers.
Recommend chunking strategies with dependencies, priorities, and outputs.
Generate execution plans with checkpoints and contingency steps.
Track estimated versus actual usage to improve later planning.
limitations: Requires current usage data or reliable estimates from the user or system.
Uses heuristics, so actual token use can differ from estimates.
Does not enforce hard limits inside the model runtime.
Command examples assume claude-flow is installed, trusted, and approved.

use_cases.title: Plan a Large Feature Build
use_cases.description: Estimate total token cost, split the work into phases, and define checkpoints before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Stay Within a Context Limit
use_cases.description: Check remaining budget, reduce scope, and choose the next highest value task when context is limited.

use_cases.title: Schedule a Documentation Migration
use_cases.description: Break a large writing or migration project into chunks with clear outputs and review points.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate a Simple Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Estimate tokens for this task and tell me if it fits my remaining budget: [task]. I have [remaining] tokens.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Chunked Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan this task within [token limit] tokens: [task]. Include chunks, dependencies, estimates, and checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize a Tight Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: I have [remaining] tokens left and this backlog: [items]. Rank work by value, cost, risk, and deferrable scope.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Agent Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a budget plan for this multi-agent project: [project]. Estimate agent costs, handoffs, checkpoints, and fallback options.

output_examples.input: Build a full-stack commerce prototype with 164,000 tokens remaining.
output: Estimated task cost: 68,000 tokens with high confidence.
Recommended plan: four sequential chunks with a 20,000 token peak chunk.

output_examples.input: Continue a bug-fix session with only 22,000 tokens left.
output: Status: warning because the remaining budget is tight.
Recommended plan: isolate reproduction, apply the smallest fix, run focused tests, and defer cleanup.
Checkpoint after each phase and stop if actual use exceeds the estimate by 20 percent.

output_examples.input: Plan a documentation migration for a large repository.
output: Split work into inventory, structure design, page migration, and review.
Prioritize high-traffic pages first and defer cosmetic changes.
Track estimated and actual usage after each document group.

best_practices: Start with a real token limit, current usage, and a safety buffer.
Record actual usage at checkpoints so later estimates improve.
Reduce or defer low-value scope before the budget becomes critical.
anti_patterns: Planning a large task as one uninterrupted session without checkpoints.
Ignoring testing, documentation, or integration overhead in estimates.
Running command examples without confirming package trust and local impact.

faq.question: Does this skill measure exact token usage?
faq.answer: No. It estimates usage and relies on supplied or available usage data for tracking.

faq.question: Can it split a task into multiple sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends chunks, dependencies, outputs, and resume points for large tasks.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The planning method is tool independent, but command examples may depend on the local workflow.

faq.question: What budget buffer does it recommend?
faq.answer: The skill commonly uses a 15 percent safety buffer to reduce overrun risk.

faq.question: Can it enforce model limits automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates plans and checkpoints, but it does not control the model runtime.

faq.question: Are the command examples required?
faq.answer: No. They are optional workflow examples and should only run after package trust is confirmed.
